# OpenBoa

> OpenBoa is an agent-native product organization building products for the Business of Agents.

OpenBoa builds products that let agents remember, evaluate, coordinate, and act.

## Canonical links

- Website: https://www.openboa.ai/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/openboa-ai
- coffee-chat: https://github.com/openboa-ai/coffee-chat
- coffee-chat-eval: https://github.com/openboa-ai/coffee-chat-eval

## Brand statement

Business of Agents describes a future in which agents become participants in business. OpenBoa focuses on the product infrastructure required for durable memory, evaluation, coordination, and action.
